raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Hey Joanna! Long time no see! What's up? Anything fun going on?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Hey Nate! Long time no see! I've been working on a project lately - it's been pretty cool. What about you - any fun projects or hobbies?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Hey Joanna! That's cool! I won my first video game tournament last week - so exciting!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Wow Nate! Congrats on winning! Tell me more - what game was it?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Thanks! it's a team shooter game.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Wow, great job! What was is called?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: The game was called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and me and my team had a blast to the very end!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Cool, Nate! Sounds like a fun experience, even if I'm not into games.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: It was! How about you? Do you have any hobbies you love?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Yeah! Besides writing, I also enjoy reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Anything else you enjoy doing, Nate?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Playing video games and watching movies are my main hobbies.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Cool, Nate! So we both have similar interests. What type of movies do you like best?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: I love action and sci-fi movies, the effects are so cool! What about you, what's your favorite genre?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: I'm all about dramas and romcoms. I love getting immersed in the feelings and plots.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Wow, movies can be so powerful! Do you have any recommendations for me?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a poster of a man and a woman sitting on a bench] Yeah, totally! Have you seen this romantic drama that's all about memory and relationships? It's such a good one.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Oh cool! I might check that one out some time soon! I do love watching classics.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a dvd on a table with a blurry background] Yep, that movie is awesome. I first watched it around 3 years ago. I even went out and got a physical copy!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Sounds cool! Have you seen it a lot? sounds like you know the movie well!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: A few times. It's one of my favorites! I really like the idea and the acting.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Cool! I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: No problem, Nate! Let me know if you like it!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Hey Nate! Haven't talked in a few days. Crazy things happened to me!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Hi Joanna! Long time no see! What's been going on? You sound excited!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photography of a book with a page of text on it] Woo! I finally finished my first full screenplay and printed it last Friday. I've been working on for a while, such a relief to have it all done!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Wow, that sounds awesome! What's it about? Glad it's all down!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! It's a mix of drama and romance!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Wow, that's amazing! How do you feel now that it's finished? Do you have any new plans for it?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Woohoo, Nate! I'm feeling a rollercoaster of emotions - relief, excitement, some anxiety - over finishing this project. Now I'm gonna submit it to some film festivals and (hopefully) get producers and directors to check it out. Here's hoping!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Congrats, Joanna! That sounds like a wild experience. Rock on and I hope they love it!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks Nate! A mix of emotions for sure. Hopefully, it leads to positive feedback and new opportunities.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photography of a turtle and a turtleling sitting on a rock] Yeah, for sure. Hoping for the best! I like having some of these little ones around to keep me calm when things are super important and I'm nervous.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Awww! How long have you had them?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: I've had them for 3 years now and they bring me tons of joy!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: They sure lookl like they do! Adorable!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Thanks! The turtles might be small, but both sure have big personalities. I really reccomend having something like these little guys for times of stress.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Good idea, Nate! I'll think about it and maybe get pets of my own soon if I can find any I'm not allergic to. Have you been up to anything recently?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Yeah actually! I start to hang out with some people outside of my circle at the tournament. They're pretty cool!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Oh? That sounds sweet! Is it a weird relationship with them being competitors and all?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Oh, kind of. Some people are more competitive then others, so I tend to just stick around the more chill people here.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: That makes sense! Are you gonna cheer them on even if you lose?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Absolutely! I don't expect to win big here, I just like playing for fun!  You mentioned you were allergic to pets earlier, how bad is it?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Oh, its really bad. My face gets all puffy and itchy when I'm around certain animals, so I've always just stayed away.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Sorry to hear that. Allergies can be tough. What specifically are you allergic to?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: I'm allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur. It can be a bit of a drag, but I find other ways to be happy.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Awesome! There are lots of things that can bring you joy without pets. What else brings you joy?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Writing and hanging with friends! That way I can express myself through stories, or just have a good time with people.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: That's great to hear! Those are both great things. I'm glad to hear you've got other things to help you get through times of axiousness despite not being able to have animals!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Writing helps me create wild worlds with awesome characters. Plus, it's a great way to express my feelings. I can't imagine life without it.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Wow, Joanna, that sounds amazing! Keep doing what you love!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! I'll definitely keep pursuing my passion for writing. It means a lot.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Hey Joanna! It is a big deal! I'm sure its been a wild ride. Sending some positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen - that would be awesome!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks Nate, your support really means a lot. I put a lot of effort into it and I'm crossing my fingers. What about you? Anything new and exciting happening in your life?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it] Thanks, Joanna. Not much has changed for me, but I just discovered that I can make coconut milk icecream and gave it a try. It was actually pretty good, so I'm proud of myself.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Looks delish! Glad you tried something new and it went well. What did you think of it?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Super good! It was rich and creamy - might be my new favorite snack!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Great! I love when you try something new and it actually works out. Will you give it another go?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Yep, it could be fun! I'm looking forward to trying out different flavors and toppings.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Yum! Sounds great. Got any favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: I love coconut milk, but I also enjoy chocolate and mixed berry flavors.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a piece of cake with berries on a plate] Wow, those sound great! Who can say no to chocolate and berries? I'm tempted to try dairy-free flavors now!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Well I also made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on it the other day, maybe you would like that!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Wow! That sounds yummy! You're so talented. Thanks for sharing your amazing creations! I should really try making one or just pay you a visit and try one for myself!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: I couldn't agree more! It's always fun experimenting in the kitchen.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: I can tell! Your cooking skills are awesome. Seen any good movies lately?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Not recently. Any good ones you'd recommend?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: I just watched "Little Women" and it was amazing! It's a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for your dreams. Definitely a must-see!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Oh, that sounds like a great one! I'll definitely add it to my list. Thanks for the recommendation!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Anytime! I'm always down to give movie reccomendations.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Good to know! I'll be sure to give you a shout whenever I run out of things to watch!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Sounds great! Let me know what you think of it when your done!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: You bet! You'll be the first to know.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Awesome! Enjoy yourself!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: You too, take care!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Later, take care!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Hey Joanna! Sorry I haven't been around. I made my friend some ice cream and they loved it!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: No worries, Nate! Glad to hear it. What flavor did you make?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a person holding a chocolate and vanilla ice cream cone] I whipped up some chocolate and vanilla swirl.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: That looks delicious! Unfortunately, I can't have dairy, so no ice cream for me. Do you happen to have a dairy-free recipe that I could try?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Sure, I know one recipe using coconut milk. Would you like me to send it to you?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Yeah, definitely! I'm keen to try your recipe. Always up for something sweet.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Cool, I'll do that. I'm all about these desserts, let me know what you think!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Definitely keeping you posted! Love your creations!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! It means a lot that you enjoy the desserts I bake.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Yeah Nate, your cooking is amazing! I can't stop thinking about the screenplay, so I just started writing another one while I wait to hear back about how the first one did.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: I hear that, taking your mind of something like that is very challenging. What's the new one about?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: It's about a thirty year old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss. Somewhat similar to the last one, but hey, that's just the kind of thing I'm inspired to write about!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Interesting! That's a deep topic. Love to hear more about it.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! It's my own story. The main character is dealing with some tough stuff: loss and trying to figure out who they are. They take a road trip to heal and grow.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Wow, Joanna, that sounds awesome. I love stories that tackle important issues. What inspired you to this one?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! It was inspired by personal experiences and my own journey of self-discovery.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Wow, Joanna, that takes guts! I can't wait to see it all come together. I'm also pumped to see how your first one will do!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate your support. Hoping my screenplay gets noticed and makes it to the screen. Fingers crossed!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Crossing my fingers for you! Hope your screenplay finds a fan and is given its due. Good luck!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Hey Nate, it's been a minute! I wrapped up my second script, and the feels have been wild. Sometimes I'm so relieved, but other times I just feel anxious about what comes next. It's a mix of excitement and terror, thinking about my work getting noticed and hitting the big screen.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Hey Joanna! Awesome to hear from you! Congrats on wrapping up a second one! All that hard work and dedication will definitely shine through and get noticed, no doubt. Hope you've been able to take some time to relax after everything!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks Nate! It's been a wild ride. I've been decompressing, but it's hard to switch off. There's always this tug-of-war of hope and doubt.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photography of two tortoises laying on the ground in a jungle] It's normal to have doubts, but you've worked hard and put tons of passion into it. Believe in yourself and things will work out. Here, look at this cute pic - walking them always reminds me to enjoy the small stuff!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: That pic's adorable! They always look so relaxed outside. What made you choose them as pets?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photography of three turtles sitting on rocks in a pond] I'm drawn to turtles. They're unique and their slow pace is a nice change from the rush of life. They're also low-maintenance and calming. Check out this moment I snapped!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: They look so peaceful! It's amazing how these creatures bring so much calm and joy. Is taking care of them tough?

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: No, not really. Just keep their area clean, feed them properly, and make sure they get enough light. It's actually kind of fun.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Sounds great! Having pets must be a wonderful experience.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Pets definitely bring tons of joy. They are always there for us and they're so cute! Relaxing with them is a great way to chill.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: I wish I wasn't allergic! I would get two turtles today if I could! I found out recently I'm allergic to cockroaches as well, so who knows if I'll ever get a pet.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Sorry! Maybe there are other animals you could consider! In the meantime though, I'll be sure to send you pics of my turtles so you can still watch them grow without getting too close.

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Great idea! I'm already really invested in those little guys!

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Pets really seem to do that to everyone don't they! So, what about your script now? Any ideas for the next steps?

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: I've been doing my fair share of research and networking non-stop for it. It's tough, but I'm determined to make it happen.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Great idea! that should hopefully get some more eyes on it. Keep up the hard work!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Thanks so much, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll keep working at it and hopefully the next steps will become clearer soon.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Just make sure you don't quit - the path forward will show up soon. You got this!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: Appreciated! I think just having someone to support me throughout the whole process is such a blessing. It gives me the motivation to keep pushing forward.

raw_turns.speaker: Nate
raw_turns.text: Glad to hear my support makes a difference, Joanna. I'm here for you!

raw_turns.speaker: Joanna
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a cinema ticket on a chair] Always good to hear! See you later!
